_comment: Attach to the ECS TASK role (taskRoleArn in ecs/task-definition-metrics.json) AND the Batch job role (jobRoleArn in batch/job-definition-metrics.json) -- same permissions either way, same split-by-role reasoning as fargate_task_role_policy.json. This one is narrower than the validator's: poster-metrics-pipeline's scripts fetch posters from TMDB's public image CDN over plain HTTPS, not any AWS service, and don't need Bedrock/Comprehend/Translate at all. The only AWS permission the running Python code needs is EFS access for the shared data/ mount. If you turn on the optional --posters-s3-bucket poster cache (see poster-metrics-pipeline's utils/posters.py -- off by default), add a scoped s3:GetObject/s3:PutObject statement for that specific bucket/prefix here; don't grant account-wide S3 access.
